title: Yunikorn k8shim: HTTP/2 server can refund connection-level flow control twice for the same data: Once… (CVE-2026-78663)
description: A critical security vulnerability in the yunikorn-k8shim package's HTTP/2 server allows connection-level flow control to be refunded twice for the same data. This occurs once when a client resets a stream and again when the request handler reads buffered data. This flaw affects versions prior to 1.9.0-r1 and has been fixed in version 1.9.0-r1.
